title: Receive a welcome message
summary: WebSockets: Receive a welcome message. Change the welcome text.
introduction: The server sends text when a client connects. The client reads one message and closes.
learningObjectives: Receive a welcome message with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Receive a welcome message

blocks.text: The connection event supplies a server socket. Its send reaches the client message handler, which prints and closes.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A WebSocket server must be listening before a client can connect.
